A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Distribution-informed Online Conformal Prediction and contain readable main text, equations, Appendices A–K, ten tables and two figures. The changed pagination does not reflect missing scientific material.

before.justification: v1 reports original simulation and real-world time-series experiments, including coverage, interval widths, robustness analyses, repeated-seed results and computation timings.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Section 4 and Appendices C–K, including the numerical comparisons in Tables 1–10.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 and the primary and CDF-based refinement updates remain unchanged. The alternative formulations and gated refinement discussed in Appendix A are also retained without procedural changes.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same five simulation scenarios and four real-world datasets: Amazon stock, Google stock, electricity demand and Delhi temperature. The added decision-making citation does not introduce an evaluated task.

E2.justification: The same seven principal baselines remain: ACI, OGD, SF-OGD, decay-OGD, PID, ECI and LQT. Figures 1–2 retain the same ECI variants, and Table 4 retains the same comparator exclusions for extreme drift.

E3.justification: The nominal 90% coverage, asymmetric intervals, Prophet/AR/Theta predictors, simulation generation settings, learning-rate selection and evaluation metrics are unchanged. Appendix protocols for recovery time, noisy CDFs and timing also match.

E4.justification: Both retain the same ECDF-versus-kernel comparison, additional shift scenarios, post-shift recovery analysis, CDF corruption experiment, scale-factor sensitivity study and temporal visualizations. No analysis or tested question is added or removed.

E5.justification: Appendix I in both versions reports ten data-generation seeds, means and standard deviations, and paired t-tests. The statistical explanation changes placement relative to Tables 8–9, but the reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–10 contain identical result entries, including coverage, widths, recovery times, uncertainty summaries and timings. The reported p-values also match, and Figures 1–2 reuse identical plotted images.

T1.justification: The propositions, theorems, mathematical definitions and Appendix B proofs are unchanged. Replacing 'L-Lipschitz continuous' with 'L-Lipschitz' in Appendices A.3 and B.1 preserves the same mathematical assumption.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about distribution-informed refinement, tighter prediction sets, joint regret–coverage bounds, finite-sample coverage and consistency under i.i.d. scores.

C2.justification: Interpretations of baseline behavior, CDF accuracy, robustness and scale-factor sensitivity are retained. The discussion of the unverifiable same-sign assumption and the qualifications concerning kernel estimation are also unchanged.

D1.justification: Both provide the same ECDF/KDE details, hyperparameters, Appendix D learning-rate grids, Appendix J hardware and timing setup, and code repository link. No implementation or resource-access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: v2 adds Bao et al. (2025) on conformalized robust optimization to the introduction's application examples and Bao et al. (2024) on online selective conformal inference to Section 2.2. These briefly broaden context without revising COP's central positioning.

P1.justification: Sections 1–5 and Appendices A–K retain their order and nearly all wording. v2 adds brief literature mentions and acknowledgements, updates affiliation and corresponding-author information, and switches numbered citations to author–year style.

P2.justification: The entire document adopts ICLR formatting, changing typography, headings, headers, spacing and float placement. Tables 8–10 now share a page, and Figure 1 shares a page with Appendix K's discussion. Table structures, captions and plotted content remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 chiefly reformats the paper and adds two brief literature mentions and acknowledgements. The method, proofs, experimental evidence and reproducibility information remain unchanged. The extensive visual changes neither resolve a substantive deficiency nor materially impair readability, leaving overall quality essentially unchanged.
